falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 60 with pattern match to March 2024 ETF rally suggests controlled volatility; sustained VIX >35 indicates panic selling that breaks the pattern, invalidating the HOLD signal as the assumed orderly distribution becomes disorderly crash

falsification_conditions.condition: SPY declines more than 8% from current level at any point in next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The March 2024 ETF pattern showed a shallow pullback before continuation; an 8%+ drawdown exceeds the pattern's maximum retracement, proving this is not the same structure and the 73% similarity was a false match

falsification_conditions.condition: Daily NYSE new lows exceed 500 for 3 consecutive sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Blowoff score 60 typically accompanies narrowing breadth, not expanding deterioration; persistent 500+ new lows signals systemic liquidation incompatible with a HOLD verdict, forcing recognition of distribution phase completion

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
